class.name: DimmerListItem
class.brief_description: A single position of the headlight dimmer switch (DimmerList).
class.description: Each [DimmerListItem] corresponds to one line of the [code]DimmerList:[/code] table. Its index within [member TrainSwitches.dimmer_list] corresponds to the switch position, starting from 0. [b]Not wired to the mover[/b] - see [TrainSwitches].

members.member: Whether the headlights are dimmed at this position.
Whether the high beam is selected at this position.
Whether this position turns the headlights off.
